title: Pet-Conduct Surcharge (Community Rules & Site Care Rules and Regulations)
content:
A pet-conduct surcharge is added to the registration-year fee of a pet under Community Rules & Site Care. It turns on the violation notices in the pets class served on the plan record within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date:

1. two or more such notices: a surcharge of $30.00;
2. exactly one such notice: a surcharge of $15.00;
3. no such notice: no surcharge.

## The thresholds on both sides

| Pets-class notices served within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | $15.00 |
| 2 | $30.00 |
| 3 or more | $30.00 |

## Points of judgement

- Only notices in the pets class count; a lawn or vehicles notice does not.
- A pets notice served before the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date does not count.
- **Hypothetical case.** A plan record carries pets notices served 2 months and 14 months before the handling date. One falls within the 12 months, and the surcharge is $15.00.
